theorem MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactor_centered_identity

def MediumAtom.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  (factorCarrier d.Q1).filter (fun p ↦ p.Coprime d.residue.natAbs)

Part3CommonPoisson.MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothNonzeroPart:
def MediumAtom.complexCRTSmoothNonzeroPart (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, ∑ l' ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexBetaCoefficient l * star (d.complexBetaCoefficient l') *
      (if ComplexCRT.Compatible (complexFactorModulus l.1)
        (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 then
          (∑' h : ℤ, CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency
            (d.U / (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1))
            ((ComplexCRT.residue (complexFactorModulus l.1)
              (complexFactorModulus l'.1) l.2 l'.2 d.residue : ℝ) /
                (complexFactorModulus l.1).lcm (complexFactorModulus l'.1)) h).re
      else 0 : ℝ)

Part3CommonSmoothCutoff.MediumAtom.commonSmoothCarrier:
def MediumAtom.commonSmoothCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc 0 (Nat.ceil (3 * d.U))
Part3CommonSmoothCutoff.MediumAtom.commonSmoothWeight:
def MediumAtom.commonSmoothWeight (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  CommonSmoothCutoff.scaledDyadicCutoff d.U (n : ℝ)

Part3TransposedZeroCovariance.primitiveZeroMain:
def primitiveZeroMain (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ((d.V * CommonSmoothCutoff.cutoffMass : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ∑ a ∈ d.complexFactorLabels, ∑ b ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
      d.complexFactorGamma a * star (d.complexFactorGamma b) *
        coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus a) *
          star (coprimeMass d.alphaCarrier d.alpha (complexFactorModulus b)) *
            (((complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) /
              (((complexFactorModulus a).totient : ℂ) *
                ((complexFactorModulus b).totient : ℂ) *
                  (complexFactorModulus a * complexFactorModulus b : ℕ)))

Part3TransposedDispersion.MediumAtom.transposedAtom:
def MediumAtom.transposedAtom (d : MediumAtom) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with
    U := d.V
    V := d.U
    intervalLo := -1
    intervalHi := (Nat.floor (2 * d.V) : ℝ)
    alpha := d.beta
    beta := fun n ↦ if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.alpha n else 0 }
